items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Monk Johnson mentioned him once but I never did get that.

ctx.x: Well, as I tell you, my uncle brought them out. It's youngsters. All of them was about 14 and 15. I don't believe that one of them was 16 years old. They had just a band of little boys. So they brought them out. Him and Kenchon. Dave Perkins used to help them. I've heard that name Kenchon. Who is that? Oh. What was his first name? He was a musician. He and my uncle were friends.
Monk Johnson mentioned him once but I never did get that. I can't think of him in that song.

But they were the one that started these little boys out in this brass band for parades. Was he here in the city? Kenchon? Yeah, Kenchon was right here in the city. He and my uncle were friends. Now I can't think of his first name.
